review.decision: The frozen implementation matches the scoped conditional-innovation design. No material leakage, estimator, fail-closed gate, CLI identity, or source-closure blocker remains in this source-only review.
implementation_findings: R10 returns one binding for each of 64 fit sequences; R16 retains 64 bindings and expands them to exactly 128 x/scored receipts. The only mapped payloads are those fit x and generated post-warmup eligibility-mask arrays; target y and evaluation arrays are not opened.

Rows are selected with the fixed stride and fit eligibility mask. Predictors are x[t-1], responses are x[t]-x[t-1], and each direction has 15,904 fit and 15,904 held rows. Transforms, three-PC basis, residualization and model coefficients are fit on the training half and reused on the held half.

PCA keeps positive covariance eigenvalues, drops only tolerated negative roundoff to zero and applies the 1e-12 score floor. The 1e-10 relative cutoff is limited to the symmetric residualizer Gram pseudoinverse; material negative modes fail closed. The N-1 covariance denominator is recorded.

Undefined component SSE denominators make the component median undefined and the edge gate false without dropping components. SSE terms, totals and gains are checked for finiteness; edge stability also rejects nonfinite values.

All six ordered edges in both directions, all component SSE summaries, and the fixed stability gate are retained. Output scope remains an input-innovation proxy, not a Y predictor, target-quality score, causal graph, or official metric result.

The CLI verifies the exact `python -m` entrypoint identity and exact observed package import inventory before reading panel payloads. The cold source-only smoke observed all nine pinned runtime modules with NumPy load/memmap sentinels untouched and Torch/PyArrow absent.
review.remaining_admission_boundary: This review does not admit execution. Root must still rehash the staged bundle before interpreter/import, enforce the fixed B cgroup/resource/output gates, and capture/stop only the exact admitted invocation.
review.test_receipt_note: The frozen source-only receipt reports 11 passing focused tests and Ruff check/format passes. It also records six NumPy matrix-multiplication RuntimeWarnings in one synthetic transform test; their cause is unknown. The tested outputs were finite and the warnings are not treated as evidence about the real-data run.
